Guldborgsund is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report utilizes data from the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) and the National Patient Registry (LPR) to evaluate clinical quality in atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, serving as a vital tool for local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. 

Guldborgsund is specifically noted for its data regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients, which feeds into the calculations for Indicator 5 (the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation treatment) [^src1]. In the report's detailed municipal breakdown on page 94, Guldborgsund's specific metrics for Indicator 5 are recorded, displaying figures such as 16 out of 1,813 and 16 out of 1,853, alongside a calculated rate of 0.9 [^src1]. Because the available corpus data focuses strictly on its statistical inclusion in this clinical report, no further relationships, timeline events, or related entities are documented for this location.
